title: Viper Monsters
paragraphs: “It’s kind of fun, isn’t it?”

It seems Father is enjoying this hunt. Well, underwater battles are rare, and I’ve heard Older Sister is specialized in underwater combat. The sea is clear and beautiful. The only issue is that neither Father nor I are gaining any experience. The others are, though.
“Naofumi-chan, after taking a break on a nearby island, would you like to go to a deeper area with me later? I know a good spot.”
“Hmm… Larsa seems to want to search that sunken ship a bit more, and I’m curious how far we can go… but considering Sadeena-san’s strength…”
“I’m fine. Naofumi-chan and the others are doing their best.”
“Nano! Let’s go even deeper! So deep that even a Filolial can’t reach!”
“Hmm! Sakura won’t lose!”
“Losing to a dragon would be humiliating!”
“Are you sure about that? Overexerting yourself isn’t good if you’re planning to race later, right?” Rival spoke to Yuki-chan in a provocative tone.
If you don’t stop soon, I might just stab you.
“Ugh… how frustrating…”
Yuki-chan muttered with frustration. I understand that feeling all too well.
“They seem to get along well somehow.”
“Nano? Filolials and dragons are rivals!”
“Oh? Didn’t he say that out of concern for her condition?”
“Gaelion-chan… was a tsundere all along…”
“N-Nano!? That’s not true! Gaelion didn’t mean it that way!”
Rival was flustered by Older Sister’s words. Indeed! There’s no way Rival would be worried about a Filolial! Older Sister’s intuition is surprisingly off.
“Well, if we’re going that deep, we might need to bring out some serious underwater gear. Let’s take a break and decide after eating.”
“Understood!”
“Then, follow Sadeena-san and she’ll take us back to the boat.”
“Okay. I’ll do my best.”
Saying that, Father grabbed onto Older Sister and moved forward.
“Ah, wait for me, nano!”
“Wait!”
Rival and Sakura-chan followed after them.
“Yuki-chan, let’s go.”
“Understood!”

I followed after them. For some reason, it feels like Older Sister is fitting in with Father and the others. Well, she’s someone even Filo-tan relied on. We took a break on the beach of a nearby island. Panda was carefully counting the salvaged coins, holding them like they were precious. As expected of a mercenary in situations like this. Come to think of it, even in the previous loop, Panda cherished the money Father gave her.
Does she enjoy this kind of work?
“I wonder what I can do with all this… Booze? No, maybe I should upgrade my equipment…”
It seems Panda is already thinking about her share.
“Larsa-san? How are you? Enjoying yourself?”
“Yeah… I hate to admit it, but I’m having a lot of fun…”
Panda replied to Father’s question with a fearless grin. Isn’t it the money that’s making you happy?
“Well, that’s good to hear. Actually, there’s something I’d like to ask you later. Do you think you’d be open to considering it?”
When Father casually asked, Panda’s fur stood on end, and she turned to look at him with wide eyes. What kind of reaction is that?
“What do you want!?”
“You don’t have to be so on guard…”
“Oh my? Then how about we have another fun night with the ladies tonight? I’d love to drink with Sasa-chan too.”
“You’re just trying to drink me under the table! You damn snake monsters!”
What is she talking about? Panda seems to be misunderstanding something. It’s probably because Older Sister enjoys drinking. What Father wants is to recruit Panda.
“Snake monsters, huh… That’s a bit harsh…”
Father scratched his cheek awkwardly.
“I’m not wrong!”
“Sadeena-san, please don’t make things more confusing.”
“Oh my?”
Father put his index finger to his lips and signaled Older Sister to be quiet. Then, he turned to Panda.
“What I want is to hire you, Larsa-san. I want you and your group to join us as mercenaries.”
At that, Panda’s earlier fearful demeanor vanished, and she scratched her head as if a bit annoyed.
“I see… So you’re trying to recruit me as a combat asset. That’s why you went through all this trouble to mingle with us and dragged me out here on this hunt, huh?”
“Well, I guess that’s one way to put it. But after talking to you, Larsa-san, and having fun, that’s not all there is to it. In many ways, I just want to have you with us.”
“Enough with the sweet talk. I don’t know what caught your interest in me, but I’m not cheap, you know?”
Father flicked a gold coin toward Panda, who caught it.
“Of course. We’ll negotiate all the terms, including the duration of employment. I’m not looking to make a bad deal.”
Panda took the gold coin Father had flicked her way and gave him a cunning smile. Then, with a slight sigh of resignation, she gave her answer.
“Got it. Seriously… It looks like a good deal, but it’s going to be a hassle, isn’t it?”
“I’ll make sure you don’t regret it. Being a mercenary means living side by side with death, and that won’t change even if you’re with me.”
“That’s straightforward. Well—”
“It’s about Sasa-chan’s idol project, right? Naofumi-chan.”
At Older Sister’s words, Panda nearly stumbled. Does Panda not get along with Older Sister?
“Sadeena-san, that’s a bit much… Well, I’m all for making Larsa-san cute, but only if it’s something she enjoys.”
“So you really do want to make me a plaything!?”
“No, that’s not it, so relax. I just want to see a cuter version of Larsa-san.”
Even after hearing that, Panda didn’t seem ready to let her guard down.
“Boss’ bento is so good!”
Meanwhile, Panda’s beastmen subordinates were devouring the bento Father had made with great enthusiasm. By the way, Father continued to cook with the monsters he had hunted afterward.
“So, Motoyasu-kun, it looks like Yuki-chan is done with her exercise. What’s next?”
“Indeed. For now, I’ll take Yuki-chan back to the stable early and discuss the next steps with the producer.”
I assume that she’s supposed to run somewhere to get a feel for the terrain. I seem to recall making such a plan. I believe it was something about getting used to running on grass.
“Okay, got it.”
“Oh? Then shall I take her back for you?”
Older Sister seemed to be offering out of consideration.
“No need. I have the portal.”
“Is that so?”
“Indeed! Well then, Yuki-chan, since you’ve finished eating, shall we head back?”
“Understood! Proper exercise, proper meals! All for the sake of the race!”
“Alright then, Motoyasu-kun. I’ll be back by evening.”
“Yes, understood. Portal Spear!”

And so, I returned to Zeltoble with Yuki-chan. Incidentally, when Father returned, he mentioned that it was at this moment, seeing me vanish with the portal, that Panda finally realized that Father was a hero. After that, I went to the producer and sought further instructions. As expected, there was training planned to get Yuki-chan accustomed to the feel of the grass. Yuki-chan seemed satisfied with the texture of the grass, but another problem surfaced—when she stepped down too hard, the grass would peel off. Because of that, she had to practice running in a way that was both gentle on the grass and fast.
“Wow! That was fun!”
Father returned through the portal, looking quite thrilled. Did something good happen afterward?
“Hm? Where did Panda go?”
Behind Father were only Older Sister, Sakura-chan, Assistant, and Mole. Where is Rival?
“Ah… Larsa insisted on loading the salvaged treasure onto the small boat and rowing it back herself. I offered to help, but she wouldn’t hear of it, so we had to leave her behind.”
